x: The pace then warmed up, and the Czech runner fell behind the leading bunch, which consisted of Carter, Worboys, Attryde, Fox, and Bettiss. With 200 yards to go, Attryde went into the lead with huge strides, with Worboys second, and Tom Carter striving to overtake the leading pair.
Les Cohen continued his recent good running by beating Pascoe, the long-legged North London Harrier, in a ding-dong battle down the straight, with Attryde taking third place for the North.
